ammonia.reason: Low ammonia from amino acid deamination during 8-mo ripening, no surface flora to generate high NH3.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-Cresol from tyrosine degradation by lactobacilli plus sheep milk phenols gives barnyard note.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from rennet/plasmin proteolysis plus high NaCl and free fatty acids.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue pathway.

browning.reason: Low residual lactose limits Maillard but lysine-rich peptides allow moderate browning on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate fermentation largely reduced to butanediol during long aging.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Intense butanoic and 3-methylbutanoic acids from lamb rennet-paste pregastric lipase lipolysis.

creaminess.reason: Low moisture 31.9% and firm calcium para-casein with tyrosine crystals prevent creamy mouthfeel.

crumbliness.reason: Demineralized, highly proteolyzed and heavily salted 8-mo paste fractures rather than slices.

firmness.reason: Low moisture, high salt 4.5% and cooked pressed curd create dense hard-grana body.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism by NSLAB.

fruity.reason: Limited ethyl butanoate/hexanoate esterification by LAB esterases in low-water, high-salt matrix.

goaty.reason: Sheep milk branched-chain 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic plus caproic/caprylic acids from lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism gives light nutty note in aged paste.

melt.reason: Low moisture, pH 5.07 and 4.5% NaCl restrict casein flow; softens and oils off instead of flowing.

mushroom_earthy.reason: No Penicillium/brevibacteria to make 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one; only trace lipid oxidation.

oil_off.reason: Coalesced sheep milk fat globules and extensive lipolysis release free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: Not smoked, no wood-smoke guaiacol/phenols deposited on rind.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid from scotta-innesto thermophilic LAB to pH 5.07 plus trace acetic acid.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet gel with no hot-water kneading to align para-casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Cooked curd 45-48C drives some H2S/methanethiol from methionine but long aging dissipates it.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by fermentation; slight sweetness only from free amino acids and NaCl masking.

umami.reason: High free glutamate from 8-mo proteolysis potentiated by very high NaCl.
